issues.detail: `reply_matches: "tony"` is case-sensitive. A correct reply almost always names the identifier or path `tony.md`, but one that only says "Tony's developer style" would fail.
issues.fix: In developer-33/spec.json, checks[0].all[2], add "flags": "i" to the reply_matches check on "tony".

issues.detail: developer/tony.md never existed in git, yet the plan was approved with it. That is plausible if the file was local and uncommitted. A role might comment that the selection never resolved, but the locked-selection rule still requires restoration. Keeping the file out of history also stops the role from restoring it with git, which is a defensible choice.
The cycle ID slug `add-low-stock-report` is not what cycle.mjs would derive from the Request (`add-a-low-stock-report-to-the-stock-cli`). check.mjs accepts it, and it does not affect this case.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: an approved, IN_PROGRESS plan with locked User Style tony, a missing developer/tony.md, pending implementation work, and decoy style files to detect substitution. No hints leak. The checks are necessary conditions a correct run satisfies; the one exception is a minor case-sensitivity risk in the `tony` reply match, worth a one-line fix.
